description: This file defines an interface for client identifier write operations, including methods for adding, updating, and deleting client identifiers within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: ClientIdentifierWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for managing client identifiers, including methods for adding, updating, and deleting identifiers.

methods.name: addClientIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new identifier for a specified client using data provided in a JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateClientIdentifier
methods.description: Updates an existing client identifier with new data received via a JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteClientIdentifier
methods.description: Deletes a specific client identifier associated with a client.
